input: Get my bike tuned up at the local shop

gold.taskTitle: Get My Bike Tuned Up Locally
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to take their bike to a local shop for a tune-up service.

questions.title: What type of bike is it, road or mountain?
questions.description: Identify the specific type of bike to understand the scope of service needed.

questions.title: Which local shop do you plan to use?
questions.description: Determine if the user has a specific shop in mind or needs help finding one.

questions.title: What is prompting the tune-up right now?
questions.description: Understand the reason behind the tune-up, such as a specific issue or routine maintenance.

questions.title: Are there specific problems you want the shop to fix?
questions.description: Identify any known issues such as gear shifting, braking, or wheel truing.

questions.title: What is your deadline for having the bike ready?
questions.description: Establish a target date or upcoming event driving the timeline.

questions.title: Do you need to book an appointment in advance?
questions.description: Clarify whether the shop requires scheduling or accepts walk-ins.

questions.title: What is your budget for the tune-up service?
questions.description: Understand any spending limits to help choose the right service tier.
